CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Forward-declaration typing gap fixed: src/emit.c's defn pre-pass now emits fully-typed prototypes (resolve_param_prototype_type/build_defn_prototype) instead of empty-parens/K&R-style, so gcc catches by-value/pointer call-site mismatches at compile time (the exact bug class behind the Star segfault, fixed separately in 9a622f5). Commit 99ef91a, Apple #15728. (sess-20260824-2252-ce890e4f)

⚓ ☃
